input.summary: Insert transition assistance, Content return and certified deletion obligations into § 3.5 Effect of Termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 3.5 addresses only accrued payment obligations, so we have added an exit clause giving us up to six months of transition assistance at IBM's then-current rates, return of our Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter. If six months is too long, we can accept 90 days of assistance as a fallback.

ops.text: Upon expiration or termination of this Agreement or any Service Option Attachment for any reason, IBM will (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at IBM's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for download all Content in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete all Content from its systems and certify such deletion to Customer in writing.
